page_title: ReqRes - HTTP(S) Traffic Monitor & Debug Tool for macOS

sources.entry: ReqRes - Native macOS app to monitor, debug, and mock HTTP(S) requests and responses. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/OloApps/ReqRes)

summary.name: ReqRes
summary.one_liner: ReqRes is a native macOS app for monitoring, debugging, and mocking HTTP(S) requests and responses during API development and testing.
use_cases: Debug HTTP(S) requests between an app and its server
Mock API endpoints before the backend is deployed
Serve local files as responses to test edge cases
Inspect plain-text HTTPS request and response traffic
Unblock frontend development without a live API
summary.what_it_does: ReqRes logs traffic between your applications and SSL web servers, acting as a man-in-the-middle proxy. It shows HTTP(S) requests and responses in plain text with one click and requires no complicated configuration. Users can mock required endpoints or entire servers when the deployed API is not yet available. The Map Local tool serves the contents of local files as responses to requests matched by user-defined rules, which allows testing edge cases without changing data on the server. The page describes the app as available for macOS with a one-time purchase and a free tier.
notable: Acts as a man-in-the-middle proxy showing plain-text HTTP(S) traffic with one click
Map Local tool serves local file contents as responses to rule-matched requests
Mock individual endpoints or entire servers
caveats: Paid one-time purchase beyond the free tier; not a subscription
